# Zugee Systems Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

> Industry-specific business operations, CRM, ERP, and GST billing software
> for Indian SMEs with 14-day white-glove onboarding, data migration, staff
> training, and Tally-compatible data exports.

## Company

- **Legal name:** Zugee Systems Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
- **Brand:** ZUGEE
- **Headquarters:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
- **Email:** support@getzugee.com
- **Website:** https://www.getzugee.com

## Pricing Model

Custom scope-based pricing determined through a 1-on-1 pricing consultation
call. Pricing depends on:

- **Chosen product** — each product is priced independently
- **Number of branches:**
  - Starter: 1 branch, up to 5 users
  - Growth: Multiple branches, up to 20 users
  - Enterprise: 20+ users with dedicated cloud
- **One-time white-glove setup fee** — covers business discovery, account
  configuration, data migration (Excel, Tally), staff training and go-live
  support (typically 14 days)

No prices are published. All pricing is confirmed on a call before any
commitment.

## Onboarding (White-Glove Setup)

Every customer gets hands-on onboarding:

1. Business discovery session
2. Account configuration (GST settings, branches, users, workflows)
3. Data migration from Excel, Tally or other systems
4. Staff walkthrough and training
5. Go-live support during first days of use

## Key Facts

- Sold to businesses in India, for business use only
- No auto-renewal, no card on file — each month is paid by UPI or bank transfer
- Monthly price is fixed for the life of a subscription
- Customers own their data and can export it at any time
- Tally-compatible data exports for chartered accountants
- Support: Monday–Saturday, 10 am–6 pm IST, by email and WhatsApp
- No lock-in: cancel any month with 7 days' notice
